Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not at liberty to give you many details on this sensitive matter. What I can tell you is as of last night we lost contact with a site housing a very valuable witness-in-protection in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. If this has anything to do with the reason for protection I'd expect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} groups to be involved. Get there and figure out what's going on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 关于这件敏感事务，我不便告诉你太多细节。我能告诉你的是，到昨晚为止，我们与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系中一处安置着一位极重要受保护证人的地点失去了联系。如果这事与保护她的原因有关，我预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}团体牵涉其中。去那里查清楚发生了什么。
摧毁被占领的基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Multiple contacts. Incoming hostiles. Engage at will, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多个接触信号. 敌军正在来袭. 自由开火，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nice to make a difference. Especially when we get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能有所作为真好. 尤其是我们还能拿到报酬的时候.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No doubt that party was thrown for our witness. We better hurry to the other settlement. They might need more help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毫无疑问，那场派对是为我们的证人举办的. 我们最好赶紧去另一个定居点. 他们可能需要更多帮助.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are two main settlements in this area. You know how this goes. Let's do a sweep and get more info, Commander. And let's hope this is just a case of some bad comms systems... the alternative won't be pretty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一带有两处主要定居点。你知道事情会怎么走。让我们扫一遍获取更多信息，指挥官。但愿这只是通讯系统故障……另一种可能可不好看。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the lance that is invading
Destroy the lance that is occupying the base
Survive the occupied base turrets in bravo base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Bravo基地的敌方占领炮台攻击下存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Survive the turret trap in alpha base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Alpha基地的炮台陷阱中存活下来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Typical hire-a-merc baby sitting job. A royal going silent is unusual though. Usually we'd hope for them to shut up. Let's hope it's just some faulty communications but expect trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 典型的雇雇佣兵当保姆的活。不过一位皇族失联就很不寻常了。通常我们还巴不得他们闭嘴。但愿只是通讯故障，但要预期有麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Commander, we need you in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system immediately. We lost contact with one of the minor royals of the region - Henriette Bosh. They frequently bombard us with a constant stream of requests yet, since some time, we haven't heard from them.

Please check on them and report back to us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
指挥官，我们需要你立刻前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系。我们与该区域一位小贵族失去了联系——享丽埃特·博什。他们一向用源源不断的请求轰炸我们，可已经有段时间没听到他们的消息了。

请去看看他们的状况并向我们回报。
摧毁被占领的基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been provided a possible location the Royal is staying at. We've had no replies on our attempted comms though, which is unusual to say the least. Let's head to the nearest location and move on from there, Team.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已获知那位"皇家"可能落脚的一处位置。不过我们尝试通讯都没有得到回复，至少可以说是很不寻常。队伍，我们先前往最近的位置，再从那里继续推进。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the lance that is invading
Survive the turrets in alpha base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿尔法基地的炮塔下存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Interrupted mid-stream? Not much does that, Commander. We better be ready for anything down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数据传了一半中断? 这事可不常见，指挥官. 咱们最好做好万全准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Last week, radio coms with a strategic outpost was interrupted mid datastream to one of the remote relays and we've been unable to reestablish contact. Our other units are all tied up, so we need you to make contact and get a sitrep.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 上周，与一处战略前哨的无线电通讯在一个远程中继的数据流中途被切断，我们一直无法重建联系。我们其他单位都被牵制住了，所以需要你去接触并取得情况报告。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Landing site secure. Let's do what we agreed, Commander. Scout out that data relay and take it from there. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 着陆点已稳固。指挥官，按我们说好的做。侦察那座数据中继站，再从那里着手。祝好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the lance that is invading
Destroy the lance that is occupying the base
Survive the turret trap in alpha base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Alpha基地的炮台陷阱中存活下来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Forward base is a little misleading, Commander. I've heard rumours it's more a spy station. Let's go find out what's going on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说前沿基地有点误导人，指挥官。我听说它更像一处间谍站。我们去看看是怎么回事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We recently lost contact with one of our forward bases in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've heard rumours of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near here so it might be related. We need you to go in and investigate for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们最近与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一处前沿基地失去了联系。我们听说这一带有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}活动的传言，所以可能与之有关。我们需要你去调查一下。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander! Are we glad to see you! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forward base {TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Alpha.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官! 见到你真是太好了! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}前沿基地{TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Alpha.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've received very little intel on this situation. We just know they went dark and we assume jamming is involved. Careful out there, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 关于这一情况我们收到的情报极少。我们只知道他们失联了，并推测涉及信号干扰。小心行事，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the lance that is invading
Destroy the lance that is occupying the supply cache
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭占领补给藏匿点的小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Head to the second supply cache
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往第二个补给藏匿点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Survive the occupied base turrets in bravo base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Bravo基地的敌方占领炮台攻击下存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Survive the turret trap in alpha base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Alpha基地的炮台陷阱中存活下来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oh sure, dropping in a merc 'Mech company to check your secret supply cache is the very definition of discretion. Commander, if this doesn't go sideways I may die of shock.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哦当然，投放一支雇佣兵机甲连去检查你的秘密补给藏点，这简直是"谨慎"的定义。指挥官，要是这事没出岔子，我可能会惊讶死。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Commander, we need you to confirm the status of a supply cache in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system that we established in case we need to execute local operations. Your company will run a patrol through the region, passing by the dumps and establishing communications by tightbeam only.

Do not attempt to contact the cache by radio and maintain a low profile, discretion is paramount on this operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
指挥官，我们需要你确认{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系一处补给藏点的状态——那是我们为需要执行本地行动而设的。你的连队将在该区域进行巡逻，经过那些储藏点，且仅通过窄波束建立通讯。

不要试图用无线电联系藏点，保持低调，本次行动中谨慎最为重要。
摧毁被占领的基地炮台
前往第二个补给藏匿点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: About time. Now to show {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} what happens when someone decides to fuck with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 总算来了. 现在该让{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}知道，惹到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}会是什么下场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} didn't want to put all their eggs in one basket, they've split the cache over two locations within a quick march of each other. When you close in to each location, we can make contact with the garrison and get a sitrep.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不想把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里，他们把储藏点分散在两个相隔一次快速行军距离的地点。当你接近每个地点时，我们可以与守军取得联系并获取战况。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Great work Commander. Secure the caches, Sumire is inbound with the Leopard to collect you and the remaining supplies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 保护好藏匿点，苏米尔正驾驶豹式空投艇前来接应你和剩余的补给.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Losing these supply caches is going to significantly hinder {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} efforts in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, Commander... and our reputation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 失去这些补给藏匿点将严重阻碍{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在 {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的行动，指挥官……也会损害我们的声誉.
脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ping sent... confirmed. Alpha site transferring logs now. Reporting no issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点正在传输日志. 报告称没有异常.
脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点——等等——
脉冲信号已发送……检测到机甲启动!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So much for secrecy. Powering up base turrets to assist you, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来秘密已经保不住了. 启动基地炮台来支援你，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thanks for the assist, Commander. Preparing to evac the supplies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 感谢支援，指挥官. 正在准备撤离补给.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a generous gift {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} left for us. Please, allow us to express our thanks personally.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}给我们留下了多么慷慨的礼物啊. 请允许我们当面表示感谢.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the lance that is invading
Destroy the lance that is occupying the base
Head to the biolab in the next base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往下一个基地的生物实验室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Survive the bioscan in alpha base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Alpha基地的生物扫描中存活下来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bio research station? We better be careful here, Commander. I don't fancy catching a new type of cold, if you know what I mean?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 生物研究站？我们最好小心点，指挥官。我可不想染上一种新型感冒，你懂我的意思吧？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of our bio research stations has gone dark in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've not sure why but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} affiliated groups have been asking about purchasing some specific supplies we also use in that system. Investigate and find out what's going on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一座生物研究站在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系失联了。我们不清楚原因，但{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}关联团体一直在询问购买某些我们也在这个星系使用的特定物资。去调查，搞清楚发生了什么。
前往生物实验室综合设施
在生物扫描中存活下来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: *** DETECTED OCCUPYING FORCE *** ... *** VIRUS DETECTED ON OCCUPYING UNITS *** .... *** ACTIVATING DEVICE NETWORK ***
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *** 检测到占领部队 *** ... *** 在占领单位上检测到病毒 *** .... *** 正在启动设备网络 ***

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: *** DETECTED UNKNOWN FORCE *** ... *** VIRUS BREACH DETECTED *** .... *** ACTIVATING DEVICE NETWORK ***
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *** 检测到未知部队 *** ... *** 检测到病毒泄露 *** .... *** 正在启动设备网络 ***

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: *** DETECTED UNKNOWN FORCE *** ... *** VIRUS DETECTED *** .... *** ACTIVATING DEVICE NETWORK ***
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: *** 检测到未知部队 *** ... *** 检测到病毒 *** .... *** 正在启动设备网络 ***

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} radio operator. You have illegally taken over this {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base. Leave or be forced out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}电台操作员. 你们非法占领了这个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地. 立即离开，否则将被强制驱逐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander! Are we glad to see you! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Biolab {TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Delta.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官! 见到你我们太高兴了! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}生物实验室{TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Delta.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unidentified BattleMech lance. This base has been put under quarantine by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Leave this area now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不明战斗机甲小队. 该基地已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}隔离. 请立即离开该区域.
病毒? 指挥官，有敌人来袭!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out, Commander! Base defenses are coming online!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官! 基地的防御系统正在启动!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out, Commander! Turrets coming online!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官! 炮台正在启动!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been informed there's two main bases for the Biolab. Let's head to the first one and scout it out. And... try not to take any deep breaths out there, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们被告知生物实验室有两处主要基地。我们去第一处侦察一下。还有……在外面尽量别深呼吸，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You leave us no choice. Contain and control those Mercs!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你们让我们别无选择. 控制和压制那些雇佣兵!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is being set in the per-contract override. Huzzah!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是在每份合约的覆盖设置中设定的。呼哈！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometimes the best strategy is to stretch, bounce, and hope you don't snap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时候最好的策略就是拉伸、弹跳，然后祈祷别绷断。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s incursions have been escalating, and a massive force is gathering to deliver a decisive strike and destroy all of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s fortifications in the area. We've been hired to slow them down, taking the brunt of the attack upfront. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s second-string units have been deployed to support us. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的侵犯不断升级，一支庞大部队正在集结，准备发动决定性打击、摧毁{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在该地区的所有工事。我们受雇拖慢他们，正面承受攻击的主力。 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的二线部队已被派来支援我们。 < 纵深防御可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b
执行一次成功的弹性防御
更多敌人正在进入防线!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Bravo base until the next base is online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫Bravo基地直到下一个基地启动.
敌对单位正在向Charlie基地进发!
更多敌人正在来袭，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold the Ground, Until You Can't
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住地面，直到你守不住

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maintain the defense and do whatever it takes to get us out of this in one piece.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住防线，不惜一切代价让我们完好无损地脱离此地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has been pulling back their forces in large numbers after taking heavy casualties. The last remaining bases are being kept online as a decoy, so the bulk of their troops are retreating without being attacked. Our task is to create a diversion, with no reinforcements coming from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s. Be advised that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} are sending a massive force, we're on our own here; save for some stationary turrets. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在遭受重大伤亡后一直在大量撤军。最后剩下的基地被保持运转作为诱饵，好让他们的主力在不被攻击的情况下撤退。我们的任务是制造一次牵制，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}不会给我们派增援。 请注意，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正派出一支庞大部队，我们在这里只能靠自己；除了一些固定炮塔。 < 纵深防御可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b
执行一次成功的弹性防御

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThan.33%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.Intro_1}We are the {COMPANY.CompanyName}!  We'll push through this and stand firm against anything they throw at us!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThan.33%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.Intro_1}我们是{COMPANY.CompanyName}！我们要冲破这一切，坚定地顶住他们扔来的一切！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It might be someone's last stand, but it's not ours, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这也许是某人的最后一战，但不是我们的，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s is forcing our employer back, so this is where they're making their stand. Our job is to hold the line and stall the enemy's advance until reinforcements arrive. Our employers say they've got some static defenses set up and even a volunteer militia backing us up. Stay alert and hold this position as long as possible. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}正迫使我们的雇主后退，所以这里就是他们固守的地方。我们的任务是守住阵线、拖延敌军推进，直到援军抵达。我们的雇主说他们已经架设了一些固定防御，甚至还有一支志愿民兵为我们助战。 保持警觉，尽可能久地守住这个位置。 纵深防御可能极为漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A few working units were activated to help defend the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一些可正常运作的单位已被启动，以协助防守该区域.
更多敌人正在进入防线!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie Base is up.  Hold this position at all costs until reinforcements take over.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Charlie基地已上线. 不惜一切代价守住这个阵地，直到援军接防.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Bravo base until Alpha base is online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫Bravo基地，直到Alpha基地启动.
敌对单位正在向Charlie基地进发!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hate to be bearer of bad news, but new hostiles are detected moving towards you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不想带来坏消息，但探测到有新的敌对单位正在向你们移动.
更多敌人正在来袭，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scopes are pinging bogies moving towards Alpha Base, Commander
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 测距仪显示有目标正在向Alpha基地移动，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As someone wise said, \"we tactically leapfrog in a different direction.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正如某位智者所说，"我们朝另一个方向战术性地交替跃进。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recent clashes between the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s and the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s respective forces have drained our employer's resources, forcing them into a retreat. The remaining bases are serving as final holdouts, intended to inflict as much damage as possible on {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} before pulling out of the area. The employer doesn't expect us to wipe out all attacking forces, but they do want to send a clear message: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will return stronger and reclaim the territory they've lost. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}双方部队近期的冲突耗尽了雇主的资源，迫使他们撤退。剩余的基地正作为最后的据点，意图在撤出该区域之前对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}造成尽可能大的破坏。 雇主并不指望我们消灭所有进攻部队，但他们确实想传达一个明确的信号：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}将以更强的姿态回来，夺回他们失去的领土。 纵深防御可能极为漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha Base is about to be hit --- another wave of hostiles incoming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alpha基地即将受到攻击——另一波敌人正在来袭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charlie Base is about to come under threat --- enemy forces are already on the move toward it.  We need to act now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Charlie基地即将受到威胁——敌军已经在向它移动了. 我们需要立刻行动!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, heads-up: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forces have fully retreated.  We're the decoy team, so we'll be taking the heat alone.  We need to drag this out, deal as much damage as we can, and avoid unnecessary losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，提醒一下：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队已完全撤退。我们是诱饵队，所以只能独自承受压力。我们需要把这场战斗拖长，尽可能多造成伤害，同时避免不必要的损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fresh hostile contacts detected en route to Alpha Base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 检测到新的敌对目标正在前往Alpha基地的途中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Great, looks like the bait worked a little too well.  I hate being the one out front like this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太好了，看来诱饵的效果有点太好了. 我讨厌像这样当出头鸟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The participants are going weapons-hot for this one, and hopefully we'll have a better outcome than the battle they're reenacting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一场的参赛者要动真格了，但愿我们的结果比他们重演的那场战斗更好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During a local battle reenactment, a large force wearing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} colors unexpectedly landed and disrupted the event. We've now been tasked with defending the settlement using the fully immersive --- and actually functional --- bases. Fortunately, the actors are equipped with real working units instead of props...which might explain why this reenactment is so realistic and attracts such a big crowd. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在一场当地的战役重演活动中，一支身着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}涂装的大部队意外降落，打断了活动。我们现在受命使用完全沉浸式——而且真的能运作的——基地来保卫这处定居点。 幸运的是，那些演员装备的不是道具而是真能用的单位……这或许能解释为什么这场重演如此逼真，还能吸引这么多观众。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostiles en route to Charlie base, intercept them, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌对单位正在前往Charlie基地的途中，拦截他们，指挥官!
敌对单位正在向Charlie基地进发!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hate to be bearer of bad news, but new hostiles are detected moving towards you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不想带来坏消息，但探测到有新的敌对单位正在向你们移动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New wave of hostiles inside the perimeter --- lock it down!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新一波敌人已进入防线内部——封锁他们!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The bases and military units in the reenactment aren't just props --- they're equipped with real, functional armaments.  This will enable us to defend the position while we wait for the next base to go online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重演中的基地与军事单位不只是道具——它们装备着真实可用的武器。这让我们能在等待下一个基地上线时守住阵地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The units in Alpha are loaded with live rounds, safeties off.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alpha基地的单位已装填实弹，保险解除.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rearguard fight isn't exactly what we wanted, but we'll make it work
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 后卫生作战并不是我们想要的，但我们会把它办好

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence reports a massive {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force advancing on several recently captured bases following their successful occupation. They'll almost certainly attempt to reclaim --- or even destroy --- the sites. The main {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have already reached the neutral zone and are doubling back, but they won't make it in time to stop the initial assault. We've been hired to engage the enemy and delay their attack long enough for the main forces to return. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat! A mighty host of foes advances upon the captured fortresses, intent on ruin. The main army hastens, but shall not reach the walls ere the first clash. We are charged to hold and harry the enemy, that the returning force may smite them in full strength.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报报告，一支庞大的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正向着几处刚被成功占领的基地推进。他们几乎肯定会试图夺回——甚至摧毁——这些地点。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}主力部队已经抵达中立区并正在折返，但他们赶不上阻止首轮进攻。 我们受雇去迎击敌人，把他们的进攻拖到主力部队回返为止。 < 纵深防御可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！ <　一支强大的敌军正扑向被夺取的堡垒，意在毁灭。 　主力正在赶回， 　却无法在首次交锋前抵达城墙。 　我们受命坚守并袭扰敌军， 　好让回返之师能以全力痛击他们。
（可选）摧毁敌方第二小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第五小队 b
（可选）摧毁敌方第九小队 b

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThanOrIs.50%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.dialogue_fancy}Their task was to give the main host time to return and strike anew. Upon the few strongholds that yet stood, they held fast, guarding walls and towers against the foe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThanOrIs.50%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.dialogue_fancy}他们的任务是为大军争取回返并再度出击的时间。在尚存的少数堡垒上，他们坚守不退，为敌人守着墙垣与塔楼。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Straight out of the holovids, Commander. A showdown at high noon... or whatever time it will be on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简直就像全息影剧里的情节，指挥官. 一场正午时分的决斗……或者说，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上不管是什么时候吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by the local Jarman brothers. With support from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} they continually raid our supplies and we've had enough. Using their overconfidence against them we've baited them into accepting a duel with us. Can you help us out?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直遭当地贾曼兄弟骚扰。在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的支持下，他们不断劫掠我们的补给，我们受够了。我们利用他们的过度自信，诱使他们接受与我们的决斗。你能帮我们一把吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These guys aren't inexperienced so watch out and good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些人并非新手，所以小心点，祝你好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} seems so insignificant. Why are there so many fighting over it?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}看起来如此不起眼. 为什么会有这么多人争夺它?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We have challenged them to a Trial of Refusal, hopefully driving them for the system once and for all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的侵扰. 我们已向他们发起拒绝审判 (Trial of Refusal)，希望能一劳永逸地将他们赶出这个星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, looks like those two guys that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} crew ticked off last night were actually {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，看来昨晚被{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}船员惹毛的那两个家伙其实是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}卫兵。看来我们摊上一场决斗了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Last night a few of our crew members took some much needed R&R at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now it looks like we're stuck in a duel with two apparent {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Our crew aren't fighters so maybe you can help us out?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 昨晚我们几名船员在当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧享受了急需的休息。话说得不太客气，现在看起来我们陷入了一场与两名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}警卫的决斗。我们的船员不是战斗人员，也许你能帮我们一把？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defeat the Guards in a Duel
Glad you did it, Commander but time to run! Reports of this duel are reaching the airwaves.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴你成功了，指挥官，但现在该撤了! 这场决斗的消息已经传到各个通讯频道了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, Those guys we ran into from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} are pretty hot headed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warriors. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}那边碰到的那帮人都是些火爆脾气的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士。看来我们要打一场决斗了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Last night a few of your crew members took some Liberties at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now you are to duel with the offended warriors of{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 昨晚，你的几名船员在当地一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧里行为有些出格. 口角发生后，现在你必须与受冒犯的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士们进行决斗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defeat the Guards in a Duel
This actually sounds like fun! I'll have you both on coms the entire time but the rest of the crew will be cheering you on from the crowd. Let's do this, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这听起来其实挺有意思的！我会让你们俩全程连在通讯上，其余船员会在人群里为你们加油。动手吧，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As with every year at this festive time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} we host an arena fight for the people. This year we'd like you to be our representative. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We're placing our trust in you so please don't let us down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每年在这个节庆时刻前后，我们都会在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}为民众举办一场竞技场比赛。今年我们希望由你代表我们出战。你的双人对决对手是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}。我们信任你，请别让我们失望。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crowd is cheering for you two, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 人群正在为你们俩欢呼，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heh, sounds like we are to be the opening act, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，听起来我们是开胃菜，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every year around this time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, we host an Trial of Position for the Sibkos. This year, we would like you to be the opening match. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Don't let our young warriors defeat you to badly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每年这个时候前后，我们会在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}为同巢举办一场定位试炼。今年，我们希望你来打揭幕战。你的双人对决对手是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}。别让我们年轻的战士把你们打得太惨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BattleMech Trial of Position. Ready! GO!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲定位试炼. 准备! 开始!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hah! Showed those warriors our abilites, Commander. Great job!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哈! 向那些战士展示了我们的能力，指挥官. 干得漂亮!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crowd is not cheering for us, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观众不是在为我们欢呼，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, pick up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还得把功劳让给别人. 真是亏大了. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会知道内情.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in a bit of trouble. Two of our pilots challenged two long standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} duelists to a fight. Only now our pilots are nowhere to be found. Can you step in and take their spots please? Of course, you'd have to pretend to be our pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有点麻烦了。我们两名飞行员向两位长期驻场的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}决斗者发起了挑战。只是现在我们的飞行员哪儿都找不着。你能替上他们的位置吗？当然，你得假装是我们的飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like those expert duelists are waiting for you. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来那些老练的决斗者正等着你。祝好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, clean up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还要把功劳让出去. 真是糟糕的局面. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会了解内情.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Two of our sibko warriors have challenged two long-standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} warriors to a fight. As they haven't had their Trial of Position, we can not allow them to fight this match. We would like you to particpate as their proxies instead, saving {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s honor, while also showing our sibko what it means to be a Warrior.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们两名同巢战士向两名长期驻场的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士发起了挑战。由于他们尚未完成定位试炼，我们不能让他们参加这场对决。我们希望你们代他们出战，既保住{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的荣誉，也让我们的同巢看看什么叫做战士。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like those expert warriors are waiting for you. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来那些资深战士正在等着你. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations it's not meant to be a real fight. This {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor is crazy. Let's uphold the truth... for a price.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的不懂，指挥官。人们说想“以战斗对抗”指控时，并不是指真的打一场。这位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督疯了。让我们维护真相……只要给钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been informed by one of the largest news networks that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor has taken issue with a recently released report on military fund spending irregularities. She's demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We'd like to hire you to represent and uphold that worthy news report, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一家最大的新闻网络通知我们，一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督对最近一篇关于军费开支违规的报道提出异议，并要求以决斗来对抗这些指控。指挥官，我们想雇你去代表并维护那篇值得尊敬的新闻报道。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The duelists are out there on the other side of the arena. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 决斗者就在竞技场的另一边. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There we go. Issue settled. Back to the dropship, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 搞定了. 问题解决了. 返回登陆舰，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You will retract that report. Right. Now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你必须撤回那份报告. 就. 在. 现. 在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations, it's not meant to be a real fight. These {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Clanners are crazy. Everything is a fight for them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真不明白，指挥官。当人们说他们想"打"官司应对指控时，那并不是要真的打一场架。这些{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}氏族人是疯子。对他们来说什么都是打架。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Trinary Leader has taken issue with a recently released report on military inefficencies. She has demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We would like to hire you to represent our allegations, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}三元编队指挥官对最近发布的一份关于军队效率低下的报告颇有异议. 她要求通过决斗来与报告中的指控作斗争. 指挥官，我们希望雇佣您代表我们，为这些指控据理力争.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The duelists are out there on the other side of the arena. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 决斗者就在竞技场的另一边. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There we go. Issue settled. Back to the dropship, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 搞定了. 问题解决了. 返回登陆舰，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You can retract that report now, or when your mechs are flaming scrapheaps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你现在可以撤回那份报告，否则就等着你的机甲变成一堆冒着火的废铁吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What do you think? Maybe we can get some of this good food and fine wine as part of the deal!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你觉得怎么样? 也许我们可以把这些美食和佳酿也作为协议的一部分!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every year we {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}s in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continue a historic procedure with the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s. We both field mercenaries and whoever wins claims a years worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a failed jumpship jump, so we've come to you for help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每年我们这些{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与当地的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}延续一项古老程序。双方各派雇佣兵，胜者赢得一整年的好食物与美酒。通常帮我们的雇佣兵最近因一次失败的跃迁舰跳跃意外全灭，所以我们来找你帮忙。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers have won this every year for the past four years. No pressure, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主在过去四年里每年都赢下这个。别有压力，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What do you think? Maybe we can get some of this good food and fine wine as part of the deal!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你觉得怎么样? 也许我们可以把这些美食和佳酿也作为协议的一部分!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every year {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continues a historic tradition with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We both field mercenaries in a Trial of Possession, and whoever wins claims a year's worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a misjump, so we have come to you for help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每年{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}延续一项历史传统。我们双方都派出雇佣兵进行一场占有试炼，赢家获得足以享用一年的好食美酒。通常帮我们的雇佣兵最近因一次误跳意外全灭，所以我们来找你帮忙。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers have won this every year for the past four years. No pressure, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主在过去四年里每年都赢下这个。别有压力，指挥官。
